data.name: Primal Sands VR
data.detailed_description:
The Desert Is Watching
Step into the silent wilderness in Primal Sands, an immersive VR hunting experience set across vast and atmospheric desert landscapes.
The wind moves across the dunes.
Your target appears in the distance.
One steady breath… one perfect shot.

In Primal Sands, success depends on patience, focus, and precision. Train your aim, learn to read movement, identify different desert animals, and strike at the right moment as you experience the thrill of the hunt in virtual reality.
As the first GCC-developed ethical hunting experience, Primal Sands introduces players to the principles of ethical hunting through a gamified approach, helping them understand when and how to take the right shot responsibly.

Train Your Aim
Begin your journey in Free Shooting Mode, where a range of stationary targets are placed across the desert. Practice weapon handling, improve your accuracy, and develop the precision needed for the hunt ahead.

Hunt in the Wild
In Desert Hunt Mode, desert animals roam the open sands. Watch their movement carefully, learn to differentiate between species, line up your shot, and react quickly as they move through the environment. Only hunters with steady aim and perfect timing will succeed.

Precision-Based VR Gameplay
Primal Sands focuses on rewarding skill, patience, and accuracy. With immersive desert environments and realistic shooting mechanics, every shot feels meaningful.
Whether you are practicing your aim or tracking prey across the dunes, the desert offers a calm yet intense hunting experience.

Take your time.
Study the terrain.
Wait for the perfect moment.
Then pull the trigger.

Key Features

  • Two gameplay modes: Free Shooting & Desert Hunt

  • Immersive VR desert environments

  • Precision shooting mechanics

  • Desert animal hunting simulation

  • Skill-based gameplay rewarding accuracy and patience

  • Atmospheric desert landscapes designed for VR immersion

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest via Link
  • Additional Notes: Requires VR headset and motion controllers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest via Link
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading.
